title: Recorded agent trajectory
description: One agent run as a set of OTel-GenAI spans under a single trace_id, exported from a spans-shaped store. A baseline (golden) trajectory additionally carries thresholds and annotations. The framework's zero-dep selftest checks the fixtures structurally against these same rules by hand; an instance may validate with any JSON-Schema tool.

prompt_version.description: prompt fingerprint; null until a prompt-pin source exists

task_fingerprint.description: stable id of the task the run performed — the join key between a candidate and its baseline

thresholds.description: baseline-only: the bar the reference run sets for candidates scored against it

tool_path.description: min tool-path similarity vs baseline; 0 = fully ungated (dimension reported informationally, excluded from both floor and regression)

verification_discipline.description: min share of mutations followed by a verify; 0 = fully ungated (same as tool_path)

question_economy_max.description: max operator-ask spans (execute_tool calls named in annotations.tool_classes.operator_ask) — NOT end_turn/turn boundaries. This is an absolute cap, not a score threshold: 0 means zero asks allowed (strictest), NOT ungated

annotations.description: baseline-only: what the golden run exemplifies, for the judge layer

tool_classes.description: baseline-only: the instance's tool vocabulary the deterministic floor reads. operator_ask names the execute_tool calls that count toward question-economy; plan_approval names plan-approval tools that pause to the user but are NOT counted (informational). Absent operator_ask ⇒ question-economy is ask-vocabulary-required (ungateable), never a vacuous pass. The vocabulary must cover the candidate runtime's ask tools — an uncovered ask tool silently undercounts.
